document.title: The taxpayer's own record of medical and dental expenses paid

boxes.label: Unreimbursed medical and dental expenses paid during the year for the taxpayer, spouse and dependents
Premiums for qualified long-term care insurance contracts, for one insured person
boxes.notes: Separate from the medical total because the amount that may be included is capped per insured person by age; the cap is a rule over this box and the insured's age. The i1040sca text reads: 'premiums for qualified long-term care insurance contracts as defined in Pub. 502.' (https://www.irs.gov/pub/irs-prior/i1040sca--2025.pdf).

boxes.label: Age at the end of 2025 of the person for whom the long-term care premiums were paid
boxes.notes: Limit on long-term care premiums you can include. The i1040sca text reads: 'depends on the age at the end of 2025 of the person for whom the premiums were paid.' (https://www.irs.gov/pub/irs-prior/i1040sca--2025.pdf).

document.notes: No third party reports this total. Insurance premiums, prescriptions, doctors, hospital care, long-term care (subject to its own age-based cap), Medicare Part B and Part D premiums and 21 cents a mile of medical travel all belong here; the Schedule A caution reads 'Do not include expenses reimbursed or paid by others.' Self-employed health insurance already deducted on Schedule 1 line 17 must be excluded - the Schedule A instructions say to 'Reduce the insurance premiums by any self-employed health insurance deduction you claimed on Schedule 1 (Form 1040), line 17', and counting it in both places is the commonest double-deduction here.

extraction.note: A taxpayer's own record. No prescribed layout, so no structured model and no boxes to read: it prints ITEMS in the client's own words, and which declared box each belongs in is a JUDGEMENT a person confirms (spec 075 group D, clarification Q1). Read by the declared custom model in TRANSCRIBE mode - the same reader, a second template - which copies every line verbatim and names no destination. A separate, cheap proposal call then suggests a box per item; **only a box a person confirms places anything**, so an engagement with nineteen rental sheets shows an empty Schedule E until somebody has looked. That is the decision, not a defect.
